senses.gloss: (Parel of עטל; cmp. Arab. ʿaṭal, a. עֲטַר II) to strip, denude.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 6:6">Gen. R. s. 6</cite> <he>מְעַרְטְלוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="N01279"><he>נַרְתֵּק</he></cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:5">Koh. R. to I, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="E00944"><he>השתק</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be stripped; to denude one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> (ref. to <he>עירמם</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 3:7">Gen. III, 7</cite>) <he>אפי׳ מצוה … נִתְעַרְטְלוּ הימנה</he> they had stripped themselves even of the merit of obeying the only command given them. [<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 913:2">Yalk. Job 913</cite> <he>והיו רגליו מִתְעַרְטְלוֹת</he> his feet were stripped of their skin (by scalding), v., however, <cite ref="P01382"><he>עִרְכֵּל</he></cite>.]
